title: A no-charge close posts with the source No-charge work order
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure AccountingHub is enabled for the organization and the test location has no QuickBooks Online connection.
  • Make sure Require Review Before Completion is off in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new No Charge work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, category Comeback, in status Complete, with one approved line with one stock part picked from inventory at a cost of $40.00 each, quantity 2 and Not in ShopView as its original.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Close Work Order in the work order header.
  3. Click Close Work Order in the confirmation.
  4. Open Accounting > Journal Entries.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The Close confirmation opens.

Step 3:

  • The work order shows the status Closed.

Step 4:

  • The entry debits 6440 Comeback Expense $80.00 and credits Inventory $80.00, with the source "No-charge work order".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11765 (Story 8, AccountingHub, the closed work order and its parts cost)

  • S8-R2: “At Close, the hub posts the parts cost entries dated the posting date: debit the mapped expense account, credit Inventory, for the cost of the stock parts, source "Internal work order" (or "No-charge work order"), linked to the record of S8-R1.”
